    add-int/lit8 v0, v0, 0x1

    iput v0, p0, Lcom/acme/demo/Counter;->count:I

    # static long field uses a register pair (v1, v2); the constant uses (v3, v4)
    sget-wide v1, Lcom/acme/demo/Counter;->total:J

    const-wide/16 v3, 0x1

.end method
